typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	FileDate as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	OverrideReportDate as timestamp (),
	QueryReportDate as timestamp (),
	RecordCount as integer (),
	TrailerRowSQL as string ()
}

source(output(
		ReportData as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CONCAT([Action],[Member_ID],[Last_Name],[First_Name],[MI],[SSN],[DOB],[Start_Date],[End_Date],[Admission_Date],[Plan_Code],[Provider_ID_Type],[Provider_ID],[Reason_Code_1],[Reason_Code_2]) AS ReportData FROM ##IN_LTSS_EXTRACT_Data_Final',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODW
ODW sink(input(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATA = ReportData)) ~> INLTSSFile
